history.summary: Freehold 1,367 sqft 4BR in West Coast (D05) at $1,778 PSF, just above the $1,724 URA median, with a solid 6.56% appreciation over 47 txns. Freehold tenure plus a One-North/NUS catchment is appealing, but $2.43M for a 4BR is a thinner buyer band and the listing reports no nearby MRT.
history.rating_rationale: Freehold, 6.56% URA CAGR on a credible 47 txns, and D05 benefits from One-North/NUS and the wider West Coast growth corridor. PSF $1,778 is only ~3% over the $1,724 median (fair). The 4BR $2.43M quantum narrows liquidity and the absent MRT field signals it isn't walk-up to a station.
red_flags: Older 2008 build (though freehold offsets lease concern)
catalysts: One-North tech hub / NUS tenant and buyer catchment
